err_payload: Invalid message data (not a valid JSON object).
err_url: Invalid link ({where}) — only full https:// addresses are allowed.
err_url_without_title: Embed {n} has a link but no title.
err_too_many_fields: Embed {n} can have at most {limit} fields.
err_field_empty: A field needs both a name and a value: {where}.
err_too_many_embeds: A message can have at most {limit} embeds.
err_embed_total: The embeds' text can be at most {limit} characters in total (now {total}).
err_too_many_buttons: At most {limit} link buttons are allowed.
err_button_label: The button needs a label or an emoji: {where}.
err_empty: The message is empty — add text or an embed.
err_channel_missing: The channel does not exist (deleted?) or the bot cannot see it.
err_channel_type: Messages cannot be sent to #{channel} — choose a text channel.
err_no_view: The bot cannot see #{channel} (View Channel permission).
err_no_send: The bot cannot write in #{channel} (Send Messages permission).
err_no_embed: The bot lacks the Embed Links permission in #{channel} (needed for embeds).
err_role_missing: The role to mention does not exist (ID: {role}).
err_no_mention: The bot lacks the “Mention @everyone, @here and All Roles” permission in #{channel}.
err_restarted: The bot restarted while sending — check the channel and resend if it did not go out.
err_no_access: The bot cannot access the channel.
err_missing_perm: The bot lacks a required permission in the channel (e.g. Send Messages, Embed Links).
err_rejected: Discord rejected the message — probably an image, link or emoji is invalid.
err_no_guild: The bot is not on this server.
err_timeout: Timed out while sending — check the channel and resend if it did not go out.
ticket_missing: There is no such ticket on this server.
ticket_channel_missing: The ticket's channel no longer exists.
tickets_module_off: The ticket module is not running on the bot.
reply_too_long: The reply can be at most {limit} characters.
reply_failed: The reply could not be posted: {error}
reply_done: The reply was posted in ticket {code}.
close_failed: The ticket could not be closed.
not_a_member: You are not a member of the server on Discord.
claim_not_staff: Only the ticket's staff can claim it.
claim_taken: The ticket is already claimed by {name}.
claim_race: Someone claimed it in the meantime.
duty_module_off: The duty module is not running on the bot.
mod_module_off: The moderation module is not running on the bot.
warn_not_active: This warning is no longer active (revoked, expired or missing).
blacklist_not_active: This blacklist entry is no longer active.
blacklist_ban_kept: The ban was left untouched (not the blacklist's, or gone).
bad_target: This user cannot be the target of this action.
polls_module_off: The polls module is not running on the bot.
